steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator or disconnect power before resistance checks or module removal. Restore power only for live voltage checks when required.
steps.sourceExcerpt: MODULE OHMMETER CHECKS (no power; ejector blades in PARK).

steps.title: Cold mold condition
steps.body: Test points L, N, M, T, H, V are stamped on the circuit module (3 Phillips removal screws). Pull water-adjust knob and snap off cover for access. Ejector blades must be in park for resistance tests. Do not manually start the cycle — initiate electrically only. Align "D" coupling on reinstall. Mold must be cold (≤17°F ±3° closes). Power off for continuity test.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Test points L, N, M, T, H, V are stamped on the circuit module (3 Phillips removal screws). Pull water-adjust knob and snap off cover for access. Ejector blades must be in park for resistance tests. Do not manually start the cycle — initiate electrically only. Align "D" coupling on reinstall. Mold must be cold (≤17°F ±3° closes). Power off for continuity test.

steps.title: Bimetal continuity (T–H, cold)
steps.body: Bimetal closes ≤17°F ±3°; opens 32°F ±3°. Continuity when mold cold.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Bimetal closes ≤17°F ±3°; opens 32°F ±3°. Continuity when mold cold.

steps.title: Live bimetal voltage (T–H)
steps.body: Restore power. T–H: 0 V = closed; line voltage = open (warm mold).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Restore power. T–H: 0 V = closed; line voltage = open (warm mold).

steps.title: Bimetal state matches mold temperature?
steps.body: Cold mold: T–H should read 0 V (closed). Warm mold after harvest: line voltage (open).

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Bimetal stuck — replace ice maker module.

steps.sourceExcerpt: Cold mold: T–H should read 0 V (closed). Warm mold after harvest: line voltage (open).

steps.title: Access harness fuse
steps.body: Disconnect ice maker from cabinet harness. Locate in-harness thermal fuse (often black wire). Power off.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect ice maker from cabinet harness. Locate in-harness thermal fuse (often black wire). Power off.

steps.title: Harness fuse continuity
steps.body: 0 Ω closed — fuse good. OL = blown fuse after mold heater overheat event.
steps.sourceExcerpt: 0 Ω closed — fuse good. OL = blown fuse after mold heater overheat event.

steps.title: Verify heater after fuse OK
steps.body: When fuse tests good, verify L–H mold heater reads 72 Ω before reinstall.

procedures.title: Test 56 ice maker errors (IME2–IME5)
procedures.purpose: Electronic model ice maker service codes

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator or disconnect power before resistance checks or module removal. Restore power only for live voltage checks when required.
steps.sourceExcerpt: MODULE OHMMETER CHECKS (no power; ejector blades in PARK).

steps.title: Which test 56 code is displayed?
steps.body: French-door / electronic models show IME codes during service test 56. Modular 2225623 uses L/N/M/T/H/V test points.
steps.sourceExcerpt: French-door / electronic models show IME codes during service test 56. Modular 2225623 uses L/N/M/T/H/V test points.

steps.title: IME2 — motor path
steps.body: Run w2225623-motor-circuit: L–M should read 8800 Ω off support; verify cam "D" coupling alignment.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Run w2225623-motor-circuit: L–M should read 8800 Ω off support; verify cam "D" coupling alignment.

steps.title: IME3 — heater / bimetal / fuse path
steps.body: Run w2225623-mold-heater (L–H 72 Ω), w2225623-bimetal (T–H), and w2225623-harness-fuse (IMFUSE).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Run w2225623-mold-heater (L–H 72 Ω), w2225623-bimetal (T–H), and w2225623-harness-fuse (IMFUSE).

steps.title: E4 or E5 displayed?
steps.body: E4/IME4 = dry cycle (no water). E5/IME5 = thermistor on electronic models; modular uses bimetal T–H.
steps.sourceExcerpt: E4/IME4 = dry cycle (no water). E5/IME5 = thermistor on electronic models; modular uses bimetal T–H.

steps.title: IME4 — water fill path
steps.body: Run w2225623-water-valve: N–V valve voltage and 140 cc / 7.5 s fill specification.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Run w2225623-water-valve: N–V valve voltage and 140 cc / 7.5 s fill specification.

steps.title: IME5 — bimetal substitute
steps.body: On modular 2225623, harvest thermostat is bimetal T–H (not thermistor). Run w2225623-bimetal procedure.
steps.sourceExcerpt: On modular 2225623, harvest thermostat is bimetal T–H (not thermistor). Run w2225623-bimetal procedure.

steps.title: Fill adjustment direction
steps.body: Clockwise DECREASES fill. ½ turn ≈ 20 cc (1.2 sec); 1 full turn ≈ 40 cc (2.4 sec). Max 1 turn either direction — over-adjust damages module.
